notes:
{切|き}れる is an intransitive ichidan verb meaning to be cut, run out, or snap.

TRANSITIVITY:
- ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧: {切|き}れる (to be cut, break, run out)
- ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧: ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut)

SENSE 1 (be cut/break):
- ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}れる: thread breaks
- ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}れる: rope breaks
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{切|き}れる: cuts well (sharpness)

SENSE 2 (run out/expire):
- ⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}れる: battery dies
- ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}れる: deadline expires
- ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}れる: out of breath
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}れる: out of stock

SENSE 3 (snap/lose temper):
- ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{切|き}れ→切る：02693_kiru⟧た: he snapped (colloquial)
- ⟦{切|き}れ→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦やすい→易い：00464_yasui⟧: quick to snap/get angry

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}れる: to cut ties
- ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}れる: to lose contact

ASPECT (ている):
- ⟦{切|き}れ→切る：02693_kiru⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: is cut / is broken / is out (of stock) / has run out (resultative state)
- Note: {切|き}れる is a change-of-state verb, so the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form describes the resulting state, not an ongoing action. ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れ→切る：02693_kiru⟧て⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'we are out of stock' (not 'stock is running out'). ⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れ→切る：02693_kiru⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'the battery is dead.' To describe the moment something runs out, use the past ⟦{切|き}れ→切る：02693_kiru⟧た.
